item.title: Within Myself
item.description: A second Ironman taught me more about my abilities, my fears, and my own rhythm. More rewarding than the finish was the life I built while preparing for it—and the confidence that I could keep it going.

item.title: Overcoming Fear: What Open Water Swimming Taught Me
item.description: Of the three legs of a triathlon, swimming is the one that scares me most. Notes on why open water breaks down control, and what building competence, staying present, and accepting the worst case actually do to fear.
